entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A human cyber ninja and planeswalker from Kamigawa, childhood friend of the emperor.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: The emperor of Kamigawa, Kaito's childhood friend, whose spark is unstable.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: A kitsune who trained Kaito and Eiko.

entities.name: Eiko
entities.description: Kaito's twin sister.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: A kami who interfaces with Kaito through a drone or tanuki mask, whose contact ignited his spark.

entities.name: Tameshi
entities.description: A futurist who built a robot to interface with Himoto and later betrayed Kaito for Jin-Gitaxias.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who attacked the emperor in the temple of Kyodai.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor fought by Kaito and Tamiyo.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A Moonfolk planeswalker who allies with Kaito and is later compleated and killed.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The praetor who confronts Kaito, Kaya and Tyvar in the Seedcore.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who is infected, compleated, and later abandons Kaito in Duskmourn.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A character found wounded and infected with Phyresis in Sheoldred's Coliseum.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who sacrifices herself and is later compleated.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who impales Jace and seizes the Sylex.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who accompanies Kaito and fears the Sylex's collateral damage.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A prince of Kaldheim recruited for the Duskmourn rescue.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: Tamiyo's adopted son who disappears and is rescued from Duskmourn.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A planeswalker recruited to the Duskmourn rescue.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A mind mage who creates an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The demon of Duskmourn from whose grasp the rescuers are saved.

entities.name: Luxior
entities.description: A sword capable of producing Halo, left by Elspeth in Jace's body and retrieved by Kaito.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The invasion tree the planeswalkers aim to deactivate with the Sylex.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Kaito's homeworld.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane the planeswalkers infiltrate.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The haunted House plane where Nashi is held.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A team of planeswalkers Kaito and the Wanderer join against New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Living Guildpact who studies the strange door on Ravnica and aids the rescue effort.

events.summary: When Kaito is fourteen, the emperor disappears after being attacked by Tezzeret in the temple of Kyodai; Kaito leaves the castle to search for answers.
events.quote: Kaito left the castle and joined the Hyozan Reckoners to search for answers on his own.

events.summary: Kaito's spark ignites when he contacts the kami Himoto while stealing Tameshi's work.
events.quote: Kaito's planeswalker spark ignited when he came into contact with the kami

events.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo fight Jin-Gitaxias and Tezzeret to protect the returned emperor and Kamigawa.
events.quote: he and the moonfolk Planeswalker Tamiyo fought Jin-Gitaxias and Tezzeret to keep the returned emperor and their plane safe.

events.summary: On New Phyrexia Kaito is incapacitated by Norn's barrier and rescued by the Wanderer, then travels with Tyvar and Nahiri to Mirrex.
events.quote: After being rescued by The Wanderer, he traveled with Tyvar and Nahiri to Mirrex .

events.summary: Jace, reacting to Halo, abandons the group to find Vraska, and the team follows with the Sylex.
events.quote: Abandoning the group, he set out to find her.

events.summary: Vraska succumbs to Phyresis and infects Jace; Nahiri sacrifices herself by exploding the Coliseum onto the Fair Basilica.
events.quote: Nahiri , who was also infected, decided to sacrifice herself for the greater good.

events.summary: At the Seedcore Jace prepares to activate the Sylex; Kaya and Kaito try to stop him, but Elspeth impales Jace and seizes the Sylex.
events.quote: burst into the chamber, impaled Jace with her halo-infused blade, and seized the Sylex, planeswalking away.

events.summary: Elesh Norn animates Jace's compleated body, Luxior falls out and Kaito takes it, and Norn invites them to yield as the invasion begins.
events.quote: Norn animated Jace's now-fully compleated body, causing Luxior to fall out of it.

events.summary: Kaito escapes after seeing Nahiri sent to Zendikar, and returns to Kamigawa with Kaya to defend it.
events.quote: Kaito left with Kaya to defend Kamigawa .

events.summary: Kaito fights Tamiyo on Kamigawa and the Wanderer saves him and kills her.
events.quote: The Wanderer once again returned just in time to save him and kill Tamiyo.

events.summary: Kaito learns from the Wanderer that Nashi has disappeared and they resolve to rescue him.
Kaito recruits Tyvar and Niko, and the team enters the door on Ravnica to Duskmourn.
Kaito falls through a trap floor in the House and is separated from his companions.
events.quote: Kaito was separated from his companions when a trap caused the floor beneath him to open.

events.summary: Kaito encounters Jace and strikes him, then they fight a fear-born creature together.
events.quote: Jace realized the creature was born from fear

events.summary: Jace abandons Kaito in a pit of gel and Kaito planeswalks back to Ravnica.
events.quote: Jace, prioritizing the others, climbed out, abandoning Kaito.

events.summary: Kaito fears his spark failed but Aminatou reassures him; Proft offers an idea.
events.quote: Aminatou reassured Kaito that his spark was still intact

events.summary: Proft creates an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn and Kaito and Proft rescue Nashi, the Wanderer, Tyvar, Zimone and Niko from Valgavoth.
events.quote: Kaito and Proft then rescued Nashi, the Wanderer, Tyvar, Zimone, and Niko from the grasp of Valgavoth .
